description: Reading from a connected service is allowed. It changes nothing, and you can see every read in the log.
Changing something in a connected service needs your approval, because the change happens outside FRIDAY where she cannot undo it for you.
Sending a message to another person needs your approval every time, and you approve the actual text rather than a summary of it. An email cannot be unsent.
Deleting something in a connected service needs your approval. It is irreversible and it happens outside FRIDAY.
